claim.quote: measured to be $\sin^2\theta_{23}= 0.51^{+0.04}_{-0.05}$, and $ \Delta m^2_{31} = 2.18^{+0.25}_{-0.35}\times 10^{-3}~\mathrm{eV^2} \cup \{-2.25,-1.76\}\times 10^{-3}~\mathrm{eV^2}$ at 68\% CL. The inverted neutrino mass ordering hypothesis is disfavoured with a p-value of 0.25.

key_value_text.value: sin²θ23 = 0.51 (+0.04/−0.05); Δm²31 = 2.18 (+0.25/−0.35) × 10⁻³ eV² (normal ordering) or [−2.25, −1.76] × 10⁻³ eV² (inverted ordering), 68% CL. The abstract says the inverted ordering is disfavoured with a p-value of 0.25; the paper's text adds that both orderings are compatible with the data. name: Measurement of neutrino oscillation parameters with the first six detection units of KM3NeT/ORCA

significance.locator: Abstract, arXiv:2408.07015 (multi-parameter fit; p-value reported instead of significance, see key_value_text)
significance.note: A multi-parameter oscillation fit, not a single-significance discovery/observation; the abstract instead reports a p-value of 0.25 disfavouring the inverted mass ordering, recorded in key_value_text.

summary.plain: KM3NeT/ORCA's initial six-unit configuration (ORCA6, six of the foreseen 115 detection units) measured the atmospheric neutrino oscillation parameters from 5828 neutrino candidates. The abstract says the inverted neutrino mass ordering hypothesis is disfavoured with a p-value of 0.25; the paper's text adds that both orderings are compatible with the data.
summary.technical: ORCA6 sub-array (6 of the foreseen 115 detection units), 433 kton-years exposure, 5828 neutrino candidates analysed with a binned log-likelihood method in reconstructed energy and cosine of the zenith angle: sin²θ23 = 0.51 (+0.04/−0.05), Δm²31 = 2.18 (+0.25/−0.35) × 10⁻³ eV² (normal ordering) or [−2.25, −1.76] × 10⁻³ eV² (inverted ordering) at 68% CL; the abstract says the inverted ordering hypothesis is disfavoured with a p-value of 0.25, while §5 states that both hypotheses are compatible with the data.

title: Measurement of neutrino oscillation parameters with the first six detection units of KM3NeT/ORCA
why_it_matters: The abstract describes ORCA as a detector designed to study oscillations of atmospheric neutrinos and determine the neutrino mass ordering, and this paper as focused on an initial configuration (ORCA6) with six of the foreseen 115 detection units.
